title: Per-launch phase cycle ledger
description: Closed-object schema for the per-launch phase-cycle-ledger sidecar emitted by the consolidated NVBit `%clock64` phase-injection tracer extension under `tools/nvbit_tracer/tracer_tool/`. The tracer injects `%clock64` reads at semantic phase boundaries (function entry/exit, basic-block entry, `bar.sync`); per-warp scratch writes indexed by `(%smid, %warpid_tb, phase_id)` are aggregated per-CTA into this sidecar. The artifact carries per-phase cycle counts that any simulator predicting per-phase wall-clock must reproduce, plus an A/B overhead-attribution record bounding Heisenberg overhead introduced by the injection itself. Pairing with a CUPTI Activity sidecar requires a matching `dual_run_manifest.json` per the dual-run manifest schema; consuming a phase ledger without the manifest emits `dual_run_manifest_missing`.

kernel_signature_sha256.description: Stable join key shared with the paired CUPTI sidecar; the join layer matches launches across the two runs by this key plus the matching dual_run_manifest entry.

nvbit_tracer_build_hash.description: Mirror of the preflight manifest's NVBit tracer build hash; provenance pin tying the ledger to a tracer build.

phase_definitions.description: Per-phase metadata: the phase_id, the kind of boundary that opens it (function entry, basic-block entry, bar.sync), and the SASS / basic-block source location range that the phase covers. Identifies how `phase_id` values map back to the kernel source.

per_phase_cycle_records.description: Per-(SM id, warpid_tb, phase_id) cycle records aggregated per-CTA. Each record carries the count of `%clock64` ticks attributed to the phase by the warp.

admission_threshold_pct.description: Per-kernel admission threshold as registered in the pre-frozen `nvbit_phase_injection.toml`; the producer's explicit finite implementation domain is 0 through 1000 percent.

admitted.description: True iff overhead_pct is at or below admission_threshold_pct. False emits a typed `nvbit_phase_injection_overhead_exceeded` diagnostic and excludes the kernel from phase-ledger consumers.

dual_run_manifest_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the dual_run_manifest.json that pairs this NVBit-side phase ledger with its CUPTI-side timing sidecar.

phase_boundary_status.description: phase-boundary mapping status. `phase_boundary_mapping_unresolved` is set when the SASS / basic-block analysis cannot resolve at least one phase boundary; the kernel is then excluded from phase-ledger consumers and the diagnostic is surfaced in downstream provenance.

phase_id.description: Stable integer identifier for the phase within the launch. Same values appear in per_phase_cycle_records.

phase_kind.description: Boundary kind that opens this phase.

source_location_hint.description: Best-effort source location label (function name, basic-block index, or PC offset). Diagnostic-only; not used for join.

cta_id_x.description: CTA x-coordinate. The natural per-(launch, cta, sm_id, warpid_tb, phase_id) aggregation rule requires CTA identity in the emitted record so two CTAs producing the same (sm_id, warpid_tb, phase_id) triple do not collapse into indistinguishable rows.

sm_id.description: %smid value for the warp the record describes.

cycles.description: %clock64-tick count attributed to this phase by this warp on this SM.
